title: Remember. Haroun al Raschid.
html_source: Stephen is trying to remember his dream involving 8th Century caliph Harun al-Rashid, who appears prominently in One Thousand and One Nights, and is also the subject of Yeats' 1923 (one year after Ulysses) poem, “The Gift of Harun al-Rashid.”
